_schema: Read by app.html's loadCommerceOffers(). players is keyed by playerOfferId(ab,player) = '<team-abbrev-lowercase>-<slugified-player-name>' (see playerSlug() in app.html), e.g. 'chi-caleb-williams'. teams is keyed by the team abbreviation lowercased, e.g. 'bal'. Each key maps to {fanatics:[offer, ...]}. An offer only renders (and only becomes clickable) once it exists here with a real url - no placeholder/guessed offer is ever added on your behalf.

_offerFields.title: string - product name shown on the card
_offerFields.image: string - product image URL or local asset path
_offerFields.url: string - the exact supplied Fanatics product URL, opened as-is by openCommerceOffer(), never rewritten or guessed
_offerFields.price: string - current price as supplied, e.g. '$129.99'
_offerFields.salePrice: string|omit - sale price as supplied; when present it's shown next to a struck-through price
_offerFields.team: string - team full name, for display/event logging only
_offerFields.player: string|omit - player full name, for display/event logging only (omit on team-level offers)
_offerFields.collection: string|omit - e.g. 'ROOKIE COLLECTION', shown as a small label above the title
_offerFields.source: string - where this offer came from, e.g. 'Fanatics official product page'

_status: INERT - players and teams are both empty. No Gear Up module renders anywhere until real, supplied offers are added here. See data/affiliate/import-format.md for how to hand Claude a batch of real offers to ingest.
